<subject>Re: Document Retention Policy</subject>
<body>
Apologies for the delayed response. For queries on this, my colleague Linda Guinn is best placed to assist – her extension is 36104. Also, just to clarify, we are not currently reviewing or amending our document retention practices.



	Christian Thompson
	7 April 2025 11:41 AM
		 
		 To: Christian Thompson
		 cc: 
		 Subject: Document Retention Policy
</body>
<quoted>
----- Original Message -----
From: Mandy Castano <mcastano@halcyonbank.co.uk>
Sent: 2 May 2025 5:46 PM
To: Christian Thompson <cthompson@halcyonbank.co.uk>
Subject: Document Retention Policy

Christian: We understand from Stephen Patterson that you’re updating the Credit Risk unit’s document retention policy. Could you confirm how drafts of lending agreements will be handled once a deal is closed? Currently, Credit Risk disposes of all draft versions post-closing. As Treasury finalises our own policy, we need alignment with Credit Risk. Kindly advise.  
Mandy (Treasury Legal)
</quoted>
